headline_marked: 9 CUET students [[detained with cannabis]] in residential hall
headline: 9 CUET students detained with cannabis in residential hall
summary: Security forces conducted a raid at a residential hall of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology, leading to the arrest of nine students.
details: Nine students of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) have been detained after cannabis was found in their possession.
The operation took place within a residential hall of the university campus.
Authorities conducted the raid to curb illegal substance use among students.
The detained students are currently under investigation as the university and law enforcement agencies take further action.
caption:

headline: Ganosanghati Andolan: No US trade deal without parliamentary debate
summary: The activist group demands that any trade agreement with the United States be discussed and approved by the National Parliament to ensure transparency and national interest.
details: The Ganosanghati Andolan has demanded that the government must not enter into any trade agreement with the United States without prior discussion in the National Parliament.
// The group emphasized that such significant agreements impact the national economy and sovereignty, making parliamentary oversight essential.
caption:
No trade deal with the US without parliamentary debate. Ganosanghati Andolan demands transparency in national agreements.

The Ganosanghati Andolan has demanded that the government must not enter into any trade agreement with the United States without prior discussion in the National Parliament.
